description: Returns the authenticated tenant's MCP credit usage for the current month — calls used, monthly cap, and remaining credits. Use when the user asks 'how many AI credits do I have left?', 'show my MCP usage', 'am I close to my monthly limit?'. OwnerAdmin or Admin only. Never returns data for demo tenants.
name: credit_status

cap.description: Monthly credit cap for this tenant's plan

remaining.description: Credits remaining this month (cap - used, floor 0)

title: MCP Credit Status
